mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically precedes a slowdown in corporate earnings growth and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 1 month, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in residential construction permits (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) exceeding 0.5% in a single month signals a sharp contraction in consumer demand, which typically leads to reduced corporate revenue growth and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where HOUST and RSAFS both decline > 0.5% in 1 month, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When manufacturing production (INDPRO) falls below 100 (2017=100), it indicates a contraction in industrial output, which typically leads to higher input costs and reduced corporate profitability, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals accelerating inflation, which typically prompts the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL rises > 0.5pp in 1 month, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a period of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% year-over-year), the S&P 500 tends to underperform as the Federal Reserve maintains a restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) over the past 3 months indicates a weakening labor market, which typically leads to reduced consumer spending and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE has increased for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals a contraction in manufacturing output, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO declines > 0.5pp in 1 month, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
